basic_details.short_information: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC), set up under the National Health Mission (NHM), is hiring one Advisor - Healthcare Technology to head its Healthcare Technology division in New Delhi, at an indicative consultancy fee band of Rs. 2,20,000/- to Rs. 2,60,000/- (negotiable) with benefits including a dedicated sedan car. Candidates need MBBS or BE / B. Tech in Biomedical Engineering with 15 years of post-qualification experience. The post is purely contractual, with an initial contract till 31 March 2028, and applications must be made online on the NHSRC website by 15 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About NHSRC
content_sections.text: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) has been set up under the National Health Mission as an autonomous registered society to channelize technical assistance and capacity-building support to the States and UTs for strengthening the public health system. It is also mandated to contribute to health policy/programme design and evaluation, and works in tandem with the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare towards universal health coverage. Work at NHSRC is organised around eight technical divisions: Community Processes/Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health/Health Policy and Integrated Planning, Healthcare Technology, Healthcare Financing, Knowledge Management Division, Information Technology, Public Health Administration, and Quality and Patient Safety Division. According to the Hindi version of the notice, the Healthcare Technology division was set up to support the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare on health technology work plans for medical equipment, especially under NHM. It has provided detailed specifications for various critical equipment, the equipment maintenance programme, the National Dialysis Programme and Free Diagnostics services. The division is recognised as a "WHO Collaborating Centre for Priority Medical Devices and Health Technology Policy" and also supports the Department of Pharmaceuticals, the Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission and the Bureau of Indian Standards on proposals related to medical devices.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: All qualifications must be from Full-time Regular Courses only. The essential requirement is either of the following: MBBS with 15 years of post-qualification work experience in administration/ programme management out of which 5 years' experience in procurement of equipment / supply chain management. OR BE / B. Tech in Biomedical Engineering with 15 years of post-qualification relevant work experience. The essential list in the notice also includes: Demonstrated experience in operationalizing health programs at field level and working in strengthening health systems, with knowledge of the latest developments in Medical Technology. Willingness to travel to states and districts to provide technical assistance, and ability to work on different assignments simultaneously to meet timelines. Computer Skills: proficiency in MS Word, Excel and Power Point, and ability to use the internet for desk research, literature review and accessing relevant documents. Excellent oral and written communication skills in English, including an ability to write crisp, unambiguous technical reports. Demonstrated ability to work in a multi-disciplinary team environment, with excellent communication, presentation skills and interpersonal abilities. Experience in Technical Specifications, Procurement and Maintenance of high end medical equipment will be an added advantage. Competency and experience of working on NHM programs at policy level / Member of Task Force/ Expert Group on healthcare technology innovations, other medical devices, or equipment procurement/specification will be an added advantage. Working knowledge of Hindi is also desirable. The age limit is 60 Years as on the date of applying. The notice states that formal educational qualification, experience and age could be relaxed for exceptional candidates. Government Officials willing to come on deputation can also apply for the post of Advisor - Healthcare Technology, subject to meeting the criteria in the Terms of Reference and on submission of an NOC to NHSRC from their controlling department. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The Indicative Consultancy Fee Band is between Rs. 2,20,000/- and Rs. 2,60,000/-. The notice states that the Consultancy Fee is negotiable and that a competitive remuneration package, commensurate with experience and qualifications, will be provided to the selected candidate. Additional benefits listed in the notice: Dedicated Sedan car Free Accidental insurance and Subsidized Medical insurance Mobile bills reimbursement and Laptop reimbursement (As per NHSRC Policy) 30 days Consolidated leave, and fully paid Maternity leave (for Female Consultants) as per Government of India policy Annual increments TA/DA and per diem for on-duty visits, as per policy The position is purely on a contractual basis. The initial contract runs till 31 March 2028, with further extension subject to satisfactory performance and extension of NHM. The work location is New Delhi, and travel to States and Districts is involved. The notice adds that all government rules and regulations with respect to recruitment will apply.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Advisor - Healthcare Technology Job Description
content_sections.text: The Advisor will be the head of the Healthcare Technology division. The role and responsibilities printed in the notice are: Lead the work of the health care technology division and develop and implement a work plan in line with current priorities of NHM and Ayushman Bharat. Enable modifications in policy and programme in keeping with technological upgrades in design, based on rigorous Health Technology Assessments. Enable recommendations to the MoHFW and other stakeholders on emerging technologies relevant to the sector. Support the identification, assessment and uptake of health technology innovations identified in the National Health Innovation Portal. Undertake/Commission high quality assessment of health products on requests by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. Lead the team supporting state-level implementation of technology-intensive programmes such as Free Diagnostics, Biomedical Equipment Maintenance and Management and Dialysis Programmes, and newer initiatives. Understand public health needs and assess the demand for equipment and other health technology needs reflected by states, against expected public health outcomes and national programme needs. Undertake progress monitoring through frequent interactions with state teams, structured field visits and online platforms. Provide technical assistance to the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare on technology trade policy, tariff structures and technology transfers. Undertake other tasks assigned from time to time by the Executive Director. Work closely with other divisions within NHSRC, RRC-NE and other stakeholders as required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHSRC Advisor - Healthcare Technology
content_sections.text: Go to the NHSRC website, http://nhsrcindia.org , where the online application is available. Fill in the online application correctly. Applications are accepted only in the prescribed online application format. Government officials applying on deputation must submit an NOC to NHSRC from their controlling department. Make sure the application is received by 15 December 2026, the last date for receiving applications. For any difficulty in filling in the online form, contact the Principal Administrative officer, NHSRC at +91-011-26108982/83/84/92/93 between 09:00 am and 05:30 pm on all working days.
